name: Autonomous Calibrator
lore: Installs into a multiblock controller for good: it follows the drifting tuning and repairs containment by itself, for a 25% power tax.
research: Superintelligence - A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.

name: General AI Core
lore: An artificial general intelligence. It asks good questions.
research: Artificial General Intelligence - A mind that can learn anything.

name: Narrow AI Core
lore: Superhuman at one thing; useless at everything else.
research: Artificial Intelligence - Photonic neural networks and narrow AI. Unlocks the Neural Synthesizer.

name: Superintelligence Core
lore: It has already read this tooltip. And the next one.
research: Matrioshka Brain - Wrap a star in nested shells of computronium and let it think.

name: Field Calibrator
lore: Use on a multiblock controller to restore its containment, clear a fault and read out the ideal tuning value.

name: Platonic Compass
lore: Points at the realm of ideal forms - and, used, takes you there (and back).

name: Resonance Probe
lore: Reads the four virtual-particle resonances where you stand in the Quantum Foam.

name: Spectral Analyzer
lore: Right-click phenomena, blocks or creatures to gain Insight.

name: Structure Assembler
lore: Use on a multiblock controller to build every missing block from your inventory. Sneak-use to preview what is missing.

name: Spacetime Anchor Core
lore: Negative mass pinned inside spacetime alloy. It holds the metric still while everything around it bends.
research: Quantum Gravity - Gravitons and spin foam: spacetime made of quanta. Unlocks the Graviton Condenser.

name: Brane Tether
lore: Ties your mass to our brane. Carry it in the Bulk - or in any field of extra dimensions.

name: Geodesic Anchor
lore: Keeps your worldline your own. Without one, the inside of a black or white hole kills you in two seconds.

name: Rift Anchor
lore: Pins a tear between universes open long enough to reach through.
research: The Multiverse - Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

name: Bootstrap Artifact
lore: Nobody made it. It was always handed back from the future.
research: Causality Violation - Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

name: Form of the Self
lore: Your own ideal form, cut in crystal. Carry it in the Platonic Realm.

name: Gauge Boson Cluster
lore: Photon, gluon, W and Z: the carriers of every force except gravity.
research: The Standard Model - Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

name: Qubit
lore: |0> and |1> at once, until you look.
research: Quantum Entanglement - Spooky action at a distance, put to work. Unlocks qubits and the Quantum Entangler.

name: Boltzmann Brain
lore: A mind that fluctuated into existence from random noise. It is very confused.
research: Psionics - Thought, crystallised. A science that should not exist.

name: Neural Organoid
lore: A pea-sized brain grown in a dish. It has started to dream.
research: Neurobiology - Grow a brain in a dish and ask it what it thinks. Unlocks neural organoids.

name: D-Brane Sheet
lore: The surface where open strings end. Our universe might be one.
research: Compactification - Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.

name: False Vacuum Membrane
lore: The skin of a Vacuum Drifter: the wall between two vacua.

name: M-Brane
lore: A two-dimensional membrane of M-theory. Whole universes can live on one.
research: M-Theory - Strings are the edges of membranes in eleven dimensions.

name: Möbius Strip
lore: One side, one edge. Walk along it and you come back upside down.
research: Geometric Topology - Surfaces with one side and bottles with no inside.

name: Attoscale Capacitor
lore: Stores charge in the Higgs field itself.
research: Assembly Lines - Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

name: Femtoscale Capacitor
lore: A Casimir capacitor smaller than a proton.
research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

name: Higgs Field Capacitor
lore: Stores a local excitation of the Higgs field. Handles mass.
research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

name: RF Resonator Cell
lore: A pill-box cavity of topological superconductor. The standing wave inside kicks each passing bunch forward.
research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

name: Absolute Dossier
lore: The research of a civilisation that has nearly finished. Feeds a Research Nexus.
research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

name: Assembly Matrix
lore: A femtoscale jig that holds a hundred parts in exactly the right place while the Extreme Assembly Table joins them.
research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

name: Attoscale Transistor
lore: Switches between superposed states before it is asked to.
research: Assembly Lines - Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

name: Cosmic Die
lore: A die holding a galaxy-scale computation.
research: The Multiverse - Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

name: Cosmic Processor
lore: Tier V processor. A computer the size of a galaxy, folded into a chip.
research: The Multiverse - Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

name: Empirical Dossier
lore: Every early discovery, written up. A Research Nexus can study it in your place.
research: Research Synthesis - Teach a machine to study. Unlocks the Research Nexus and Empirical Dossiers; later dossiers come with later research.

name: Engineered Enzyme
lore: A protein designed to speed up exactly one reaction a millionfold.
research: Genomics - Four letters, three billion of them. Unlocks the Gene Sequencer, recombinant DNA and engineered enzymes.

name: Femtoscale Transistor
lore: A single-qubit switch.
research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

name: Hilbert's Hotel Key
lore: Opens room n+1. There is always a room n+1.

name: Hyperdimensional Die
lore: A die that is larger on the inside.
research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

name: Hyperdimensional Processor
lore: Tier IV processor. Its logic gates take inputs from directions that do not exist.
research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

name: Ontological Processor
lore: Tier VI processor. It does not compute answers - it decides what is true.
research: The Simulation Hypothesis - If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.

name: Photonic Die
lore: A single photonic logic die.
research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

name: Photonic Processor
lore: Tier I processor. Computes with light.
research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

name: Pixel Tracker Module
lore: A qubit-array sensor that records the exact path of every charged particle crossing it.
research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

name: Quantum Processor
lore: A fault-tolerant array of logical qubits.
research: Matrioshka Brain - Wrap a star in nested shells of computronium and let it think.

name: Qubit Die
lore: A single die of entangled qubits.
research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

name: Theoretical Dossier
lore: The theories of the middle ages of your research. Feeds a Research Nexus.
research: Superintelligence - A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.

name: Topological Die
lore: A die of topologically protected logic.
research: Topological Matter - Phases of matter protected by topology rather than symmetry.

name: Topological Processor
lore: Tier III processor. Fault-tolerant by geometry.
research: Assembly Lines - Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

name: Transfinite Processor
lore: Tier VII processor. Finishes infinitely many operations in finite time.
research: Incompleteness - Any system strong enough to describe arithmetic contains truths it can never prove - reality included.

name: Unified Dossier
lore: Everything up to the edge of mathematics, unified. Feeds a Research Nexus.
research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

name: Arbor Heartwood Sample
lore: Wood from the World Tree. It is warm, cold, heavy and weightless, sometimes all at once.

name: Degenerate Matter Chunk
lore: Electron-degenerate matter from a dead star's core. Absurdly heavy.
research: Cosmogenesis - False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

name: Fractured Essence
lore: A splinter of reality that broke away from a destabilised creature. It is in several places at once.

name: Paradox Residue
lore: What is left after a contradiction resolves itself.
research: The Axiomatic Breach - Break every law of physics and mathematics at once, and step through the hole. Unlocks the Axiomatic Breach Engine and the Axiom Key.

name: Primordial Ejecta
lore: Matter a white hole threw out before there was anything to throw.

name: Self-Healing Polymer
lore: Cut it and the chains find each other again.
research: Supramolecular Chemistry - Molecules that build themselves into cages, frameworks and machines. Unlocks MOFs, clathrates and self-healing polymers.

name: Spacetime Slag
lore: Crumpled leftover geometry. A Maxwell's demon can sort useful shards out of it.
research: Fractional Distillation - High-tier processes leave Dimensional Residue. Distil it back into useful matter in the Fractionation Spire.

name: Supernova Remnant
lore: What is left after a star's core collapses and its outer layers are blasted across the galaxy.
research: Nucleosynthesis - Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.

name: Tidal Alloy Scrap
lore: Metal pulled thin by tides stronger than its bonds.
